mapper.select: SELECT r.code, r.name, r.created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.permission_id) as permission_count, COALESCE( array_agg(DISTINCT p.resource ORDER BY p.resource) FILTER (WHERE p.resource IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::varchar[] ) as resources, COALESCE( json_agg( json_build_object('resource', p.resource, 'action', p.action) ORDER BY p.resource, p.action ) FILTER (WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json ) as permission_details FROM admin_roles r LEFT JOIN admin_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN admin_permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id GROUP BY r.id, r.code, r.name, r.created_at ORDER BY r.code

SELECT u.id::text as user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, COALESCE( json_agg( json_build_object('code', r.code, 'name', r.name) ORDER BY r.code ) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json ) as roles, COALESCE( ( SELECT json_agg( json_build_object('resource', sub.resource, 'action', sub.action) ) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT p.resource, p.action FROM admin_user_roles ur2 LEFT JOIN admin_role_permissions rp2 ON rp2.role_id = ur2.role_id LEFT JOIN admin_permissions p ON p.id = rp2.permission_id WHERE ur2.user_id = u.id AND p.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.resource, p.action ) sub ), '[]'::json ) as permissions FROM users u INNER JOIN admin_user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.full_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') )
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name ORDER BY u.username

SELECT u.id::text as user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, CASE WHEN ur.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as has_admin_access FROM users u LEFT JOIN admin_user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') OR u.full_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%') )
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, ur.user_id ORDER BY has_admin_access DESC, u.username LIMIT 50

SELECT u.id::text as user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, COALESCE( json_agg( json_build_object('code', r.code, 'name', r.name) ORDER BY r.code ) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json ) as roles, COALESCE( ( SELECT json_agg( json_build_object('resource', sub.resource, 'action', sub.action) ) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT p.resource, p.action FROM admin_user_roles ur2 LEFT JOIN admin_role_permissions rp2 ON rp2.role_id = ur2.role_id LEFT JOIN admin_permissions p ON p.id = rp2.permission_id WHERE ur2.user_id = u.id AND p.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.resource, p.action ) sub ), '[]'::json ) as permissions FROM users u LEFT JOIN admin_user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.id = #{userId, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name
